stem: The set of values of k for which the circle $C : 4x^2 + 4y^2 - 12x + 8y + k = 0$ lies inside the fourth quadrant and the point $\left(1, -\frac13\right)$ lies on or inside the circle $C$ is:
solution:
$x^2 + y^2 - 3x + 2y + \frac k4 = 0$: centre $\left(\frac32, -1\right)$, $r = \dfrac{\sqrt{13-k}}{2}$, so $k \le 13$.

Point $\left(1, -\frac13\right)$ on or inside: $S_1 \le 0 \Rightarrow k \le \dfrac{92}{9}$.

Circle in 4th quadrant: $r < 1 \Rightarrow k > 9$. Hence $k \in \left(9, \dfrac{92}{9}\right]$
